title: The Letter
game: The City That Forgot the Moon
controls: Use the on-screen joystick to move. Tap INTERACT near a blue memory shard. Tap JOURNAL to review clues.

stages.name: The Quiet Street
stages.objective: Learn movement and find the first blue memory.

stages.name: The Forgotten House
stages.objective: Discover a clue about a key and the missing moon.

stages.name: Strange Footprints
stages.objective: Follow the trail and recover another memory.
stages.hint: The next blue light is farther away.

stages.name: Meet Mira
stages.objective: Find the final memory and learn who remembers the moon.
stages.hint: Search for the last blue light.

collectibles.clue: The moon did not leave. It was hidden.
A tower bell rang beneath a red sky.
Find the tower beyond the river.

ending: A voice in the fog says: I remember the moon. Chapter 1 complete.
